snippet.title: The Alters | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order on consoles and wishlist on Steam: http://re.11bits.com/tmh 

The Alters launches June 13, on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and on day one on Xbox Game Pass and PC Game Pass 💜

What if all the choices you made were just an illusion? Is escape a selfish goal? And if there's an easy way out, would you take it? Because in #TheAlters, survival is personal. 

Music: "We Might Be Dead By Tomorrow" by SOKO 
@SoKoMusic
